items.description: A tiny trend line without axes for beside a figure or in a table cell, with a dot on the latest point, a tooltip and a 44 px keyboard and touch target however thin it is.

items.name: sparkline-demo
items.title: Sparkline demo
items.description: How to use Sparkline.

items.name: dot-matrix
items.title: Dot matrix
items.description: A grid of dots that grow with the value, such as payments per weekday and hour, with a now cell, keyboard reading and a table for screen readers.

items.name: dot-matrix-demo
items.title: Dot matrix demo
items.description: How to use Dot matrix.

items.name: donut
items.title: Donut
items.description: A thick ring of rounded segments with gaps, a centre figure and a legend list; point at a segment or a row and it steps out while the centre reads its value and share.

items.name: donut-demo
items.title: Donut demo
items.description: How to use Donut.

items.name: dial
items.title: Dial
items.description: A fat arc of rounded segments that light up to a value with a marker in the signal colour, or a three-zone gauge with a needle; read-only or a slider you can drag or key.

items.name: dial-demo
items.title: Dial demo
items.description: How to use Dial.

items.name: bubble-chart
items.title: Bubble chart
items.description: A bubble chart sized by value: on two axes when items have x and y, packed largest-first otherwise, with direct labels where they fit, one tooltip and one Tab stop with arrow keys.

items.name: bubble-chart-demo
items.title: Bubble chart demo
items.description: How to use Bubble chart.

items.name: lollipop
items.title: Lollipop
items.description: A ranked list with thin stems and round heads at each value: sort by value or name and the rows slide into place; one Tab stop with arrow keys, a tooltip per row, and the list itself is the data for screen readers.

items.name: lollipop-demo
items.title: Lollipop demo
items.description: How to use Lollipop.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card stack
items.description: A fanned stack of payment or account cards: drag, flick, tap or key the front card away and the next comes forward, with its balance under the fan and dots to pick a card.

items.name: card-stack-demo
items.title: Card stack demo
items.description: How to use Card stack.

items.name: transaction-list
items.title: Transaction list
items.description: Payments grouped by day with the day's net, signed amounts in tabular mono, incoming, pending and failed states that never rely on colour alone, and a show-more limit.

items.name: transaction-list-demo
items.title: Transaction list demo
items.description: How to use Transaction list.

items.name: week-schedule
items.title: Week schedule
items.description: A week by the hour with events in side-by-side lanes when they overlap, 44 px minimum blocks, a now line in the signal colour, and day tabs when the columns get too narrow.

items.name: week-schedule-demo
items.title: Week schedule demo
items.description: How to use Week schedule.
